careAlerts.description: Send a gentle notification when your pet becomes unwell from neglect.
careAlerts.label: Care alerts

customBubbles.description: Add your own phrases; the pet sprinkles them into its reactions.
customBubbles.label: Catchphrases

clickThrough.description: Let clicks pass through the pet to whatever is behind it.
clickThrough.label: Click-through

desktopPet.clickThroughHint: While click-through is on, the desktop pet ignores the mouse. Turn it back off here or from the tray menu's "Disable click-through".
desktopPet.description: Float the pet on your desktop in a transparent always-on-top window (desktop app only).

enabled.description: Show the pet floating on your desktop, outside the app window.
enabled.label: Desktop pet

desktopPet.hotkeyLink: Configure a global hotkey to show/hide the desktop pet
desktopPet.title: Desktop pet

climbWindows.description: Let the pet climb onto and perch on the top edges of your open windows. Throw it onto a window to sit it there. Experimental; Windows and macOS only.
climbWindows.label: Climb onto windows
climbWindows.unsupportedPlatform: Not available on Linux — there's no stable way to read other apps' window positions.

wander.description: Let the desktop pet stroll along the bottom of your screen on its own.

enabled.description: The pet occasionally walks to a new spot. Throwing it with a quick drag always works.
enabled.label: Enable wandering

onlyAfterInteraction.description: Walks start only within a few minutes of any computer activity — petting the pet, typing, or moving the mouse. When you step away, the pet rests too.
onlyAfterInteraction.label: Only move while you're active

wander.title: Wandering

config.description: Adjust how this model is placed and which motions play for each pet state. Changes preview live and apply on save.
config.previewUnavailable: Live preview needs the Live2D runtime — settings still save.
config.title: Customize {name}

live2d.coreMissing: Live2D runtime isn't ready — the pet will fall back to the SVG skin.

errors.downloadFailed: The sample model couldn't be downloaded.
errors.invalidJson: The settings file isn't valid JSON.
errors.missingReferenced: The model is missing files it references.
errors.multipleSettings: More than one .model3.json was found — keep just one.
errors.tooLarge: The model is larger than the 50 MB limit.

live2d.importHint: Choose a model folder or a .zip containing a .model3.json.
live2d.noModels: No Live2D models yet. Import one or download a sample.
live2d.title: Live2D models

llmSpeak.description: Let the pet answer typed talk messages with a tiny AI reply (opt-in, rate-limited, PII-gated).
llmSpeak.label: Talk with AI
llmSpeak.modelHint: Pick a cheap, fast model — replies are one short sentence.

lowPower.description: Cap the Live2D frame rate at 30 fps and make wandering rest longer.
lowPower.label: Low-power mode

memory.clearDescription: Forget everything the pet remembers from your talks.
memory.description: Remember recent talk exchanges and weave them into replies. Stored locally, capped at 200 turns.
memory.label: Conversation memory

mutedBubbles.description: Keep the pet quiet (it still animates).
mutedBubbles.label: Mute bubbles

proactive.description: The pet speaks up on its own — celebrating milestones, chatting when idle, greeting by time of day. Quiet hours are always respected.

enabled.description: Off by default. Uses the same model as Talk with AI, with a daily cap and minimum gap.
enabled.label: Let the pet speak up

eventComments.description: Level-ups, evolutions, completed goals, achievements, and workflow runs.
eventComments.label: Comment on milestones

idleChatter.description: Speak up after you've been away from the computer for a while.
idleChatter.label: Idle chatter

timeGreetings.description: A morning hello and a late-night reminder to rest, once per day each.
timeGreetings.label: Time greetings

proactive.title: Proactive speech

reset.description: Delete all pet data and start over.
reset.label: Reset pet

sound.description: Play short sounds when you touch the pet or it reacts. Off by default.
sound.label: Sound effects

quietHours.description: Silence pet sounds during this window.
quietHours.label: Quiet hours

twinAwareness.description: Let the pet's mood react to a Twin's background activity — job counts and timestamps only, never the Twin's actual content. Off by default.

enabled.description: The pet looks busy while the watched Twin has work queued, and celebrates when it finishes learning something new.
enabled.label: React to Twin activity

twinAwareness.privacyNote: Only reads job status and timestamps from the watched Twin — never its sources, chunks, or distilled profile.
twinAwareness.title: Twin awareness

twinSelect.empty: You don't have any Twins yet.
twinSelect.label: Watched Twin
